title: DEBT31: The path guard never reads code, so a decision cited by path in a comment goes…
note: `check_paths` (the `paths` row) is called only with markdown files. A decision cited by its filename in a code comment, as in `store/numbers.py` and `store/orders.py`, is never resolved, and a mistyped one is invisible. `decision ids in code` resolves a bare `D<n>` in `.py`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.css` and `.js`, and never reads the path around it. A dead path citation once shipped this way: a comment in `scripts/docs-audit.py` cited a decision file without its slug. Action line: step audit-2-10.
